div.p: Bernice McPherson Ceramic tiles and asphalt 1995 Corner of Buncle and Catyre Streets, North Melbourne (Melway ref. 2A E5)

This artwork resulted from a collaborative project between Bernice McPherson and local residents. Comprising nine large, asphalt squares inset with small glazed-ceramic tiles, the work is sited in the pathway leading into Hotham Estate.
